messages:
maria: Quick heads-up 11 launching a focused experiment for the pricing micro-calculator + CTA routing today. I updated the FAQ snippet in the doc: https://docs.redwood.com/sheets/pricing-mini-calc

devon: Good timing. Which CTA routing split are we doing? Webinar vs demo?

maria: Variant 1 -> webinar sign-up (lightweight). Variant 2 -> demo request (sales). Goal: measure trial conversion after webinar nurture vs demo outreach.

ashley: Proposal: add a tiny tokens-per-month slider inline so users get an immediate price band. Keeps people on the page. :memo:

kevin: Agreed. Keep it client-side (JS map) to avoid extra server calls. Quick pseudo: ```js
const tiers = ["Free","Starter","Performance","Enterprise"];
function bucket(tokens){ return tiers[Math.min(Math.floor(tokens/50000), tiers.length-1)]; }
```

samir: Heads-up: I suggested renaming "Scale" to "Performance" for clarity about latency/throughput. That will change labels in the calculator.

maria: Ops prefers minimal naming churn today. Can we A/B test the label in the calculator UI only (frontend flag) and keep canonical docs unchanged?

devon: Yep. I'll add a launch flag: X_EXP_CALC_TIER_LABEL=perf_label_test and wire it into the front end routing.

ashley: Measurement plan: events = [`pricing_calc_open`, `estimator_interact`, `cta_click`]. Capture properties: `variant`, `tier_label`, `inbound_route` (webinar|demo).

webinar-bot: Reminder: update webinar reg page link with UTMs: `?utm_source=pricing_flow&utm_campaign=calc_experiment_apr`

kevin: Small copy ask: under the Performance label can we include one-line micro-benchmark like "~2060ms median token latency on p4-class infra" to signal suitability for low-latency apps. Keep it approximate.

samir: I'll validate numbers with infra so we don't overpromise.

maria: Draft copy posted to doc: "Performance 11 for latency-sensitive apps. Typical median token latency ~2060ms depending on model and infra." Flag if that looks off.

devon: Launch plan: rollout to 15% NSW (Australia) at 14:00 UTC, monitor errors + engagement for 2 hours, then widen if stable. Feature flag ready.

maria: I'll schedule a short launch note and a webinar reminder email cadence. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
